name: Terminal Synaptique
description: Nœud Prime centralisant les opérations de guerre cybernétique de l'Omni-Réseau sur tous les fronts simultanément.

subject.archetype: Synaptic War Node – Cyber-Enhanced Combat Specialist

loadout.armor_outfit: Mass-produced composite exoskeleton with matte black armor plates over a utilitarian bodysuit, integrated neural-link ports and sleek angular plating; heavy cables run from the spine to the weapon grip
loadout.arsenal: Standardized geometric assault rifle with wrist-mounted neural coupling, close-combat high-frequency blade, and a compact EMP grenade launcher

attitude.behavior: Low sweeping strike, arm fully extended toward a nearby enemy, dark corruption tendrils erupting from fingertips and burrowing into the target, while the backdrop features collapsing server towers and shattered holographic displays
attitude.emotion: Cold, emotionless focus; eyes glowing faintly with neon-blue neural light; void of fear or compassion

palette_names.name: Cold Neon Blue
palette_names.role: Neural implants, optic glows, and energy accents

palette_names.name: Electric Cyan
palette_names.role: Sparks, electric storms, and holographic glitches

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Cinematic low‑key lighting with blue‑neon rim lights, harsh point lights from sparking server towers, and occasional flash of electric arcs; high contrast shadows emphasize gritty realism
color_and_light.mood: Menacing, chaotic, and intense – a battlefield dominated by digital decay and relentless aggression

camera.angle: Low angle with a subtle Dutch tilt, emphasizing the combatant’s powerful forward motion

scenography.setting: Cyber warfare zone – shattered holographic displays, crumbling digital fortifications under enemy ICE attacks, toppling server towers emitting sparks, and an electric storm rippling through the infrastructure
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Glitching holograms, blue electric arcs, dark corruption tendrils expanding from the combatant’s fingertips, rain of digital debris, low‑lying fog, and flickering code fragments
